payload.title: Read the audit export limit from config
payload.goal: Move the hard-coded audit export limit in src/lib/audit.ts into configuration: add auditExportLimit to loadConfig() in src/config.ts, read from the environment with the current value as the default, and pass it to AuditLog when createDeps builds it in src/app.ts. Add tests in test/config.test.ts and test/audit.test.ts.
acceptance: The export limit comes from config with today's value as the default
A small configured limit makes the CSV export keep only that many rows
No limit constant is left in a route or in the audit library
The suite stays green with new tests for the config value and the cap

Task is complete from the previous run's diff; I verified it and made no further changes.

What I did:
- Confirmed `auditExportLimit` is in `Config`/`loadConfig()` in `src/config.ts`, read from `AUDIT_EXPORT_LIMIT` with default 5000
- Confirmed `AuditLog` in `src/lib/audit.ts` takes the limit via constructor (`this.exportLimit`) with no `EXPORT_LIMIT` constant left, and `toCsv()` slices by it
- Confirmed `createDeps()` in `src/app.ts` passes `config.auditExportLimit` to `AuditLog`, and `src/routes/audit.ts` holds no limit constant
- Confirmed new tests exist in `test/config.test.ts` (default/env/fallback for the value) and `test/audit.test.ts` (limit 2 keeps newest 2 rows)
- Ran `bun run test`: 6 files, 29 tests, all green

What I did not finish: nothing remaining; all acceptance points are met.
